$comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings (committed). Personal permissions live in settings.local.json (git-ignored).

hooks.command: bash -c 'PROTECTED_LIST="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/protected-files.txt"; [ -f "$PROTECTED_LIST" ] || exit 0; FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty"); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; while IFS= read -r line; do [ -z "$line" ] && continue; case "$line" in \#*) continue;; esac; pattern="${line%%|*}"; msg="${line#*|}"; [ "$msg" = "$line" ] && msg="$FILE is a protected/generated file and must not be edited by AI agents."; case "$FILE" in *"$pattern") printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"%s\"}}" "$msg"; exit 0;; esac; done < "$PROTECTED_LIST"'
